name: Glory

date.source: The promotion's own release announcement, 12 January 2002.

evidence.source: The promotion's own release announcement (12 January 2002) and the thread it drew, served at /promotions/rcw-nz-2004/archive/rcw-glory-first-pay-per-view-2002-01-12.html
evidence.note: Billed as the promotion's first pay-per-view and posted as three hourly text files on its own website; the files themselves do not survive here. Replies name a light-heavyweight title match and two bouts near ten thousand words.

notes: Released in three hours as files on the promotion's own website; the card text is not held here.

name: Caged Rage 2

date.source: The promotion's own release announcement, 24 March 2002.

evidence.source: The promotion's own release announcement (24 March 2002), served at /promotions/rcw-nz-2004/archive/rcw-caged-rage-2-2002-03-24.html, and its placing in the newsgroup's 2002 mid-year awards, served at /promotions/rcw-nz-2004/archive/rcw-mid-year-awards-2002-07-09.html
evidence.note: A single-file pay-per-view on the promotion's own website; the card text is not held here. One of its bouts placed fifth for best match of the mid-year.

notes: The second Caged Rage; a third followed in 2004. The card text is not held here.
